title: Annotatio III §.V: Rather pray imitation across Germany, neighboring northern kingdoms, and all Europe wherever both Protestant parties are found
pass_a_gloss: rather having prayed with the whole breast for the imitation of so salutary, wise, and altogether Christian a deed and example, to the Protestants in our Germany, and to other neighboring northern kingdoms, nay in the whole European world, wherever at length Protestants of either party are found,
pass_b_english: Better to pray with whole heart that Protestants in our Germany, in the neighboring northern kingdoms, and throughout Europe — wherever either party’s Protestants are found — imitate so wholesome, clear-headed, and thoroughly Christian a deed and example.
source_text: imitationem potiùs tàm salutaris, cordati ac Christiani prorsus facti atque exempli, Protestantibus in Germania nostra, aliisque vicinis regnis septentrionalibus, quin in orbe Europaeo integro, ubicunque tandem Protestantes utriusque partis inveniuntur, totô pectore apprecati,
notes: Imitation prayer: Germany, northern kingdoms, whole Europe, both parties.
